versions.changelog:
- Increased minimum Aliyun CLI version requirement to 3.3.3 and provided direct update/install instructions.
- Enforced [MUST] inclusion of a specific user-agent string in every aliyun CLI invocation.
- Introduced mandatory CLI "AI-mode" enable/disable steps before and after the skill workflow, with strict requirements for consistent state management.
- Updated references to use the new user-agent format in code samples and documentation.
- Improved pre-check section guidance for CLI installation and plugin updates.
- No workflow or business logic changes outside of CLI and operational control practices.

Initial release: Best practice skill for building AI-driven coaching systems on AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL (ADBPG)

- Guides users to build RAG-driven coaching systems by integrating Supabase (for structured data) with ADBPG instances (vector optimization).
- Outlines core workflow for setting up Supabase projects, ADBPG vector knowledge bases, and all required cloud networking (NAT Gateway, EIP).
- Details required RAM permissions and security guidelines for credential handling.
- Provides scenario descriptions, architecture diagrams, and step-by-step pre-checks for cloud CLI and permissions.
- Enables "smart defaults" for quick setup, with auto region/VPC parsing and minimal user input.
